messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The voiceover will be sent next Friday afternoon.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright then

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hello, I'm sending over both the voiceover and the preferred voiceover audit feedback. Thank you.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Any news ?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: It's in progress and should be ready shortly.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thank you! Could you confirm that you saw the files? I'm checking because there have been times when people didn't receive an upwork notification.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: This is for you, Feld.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: What's happening here? I don't quite understand it =)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The middle part is intended for comments.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The current state points to a complete revision. It now appears that the entire thing has to be changed.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: This is filled with a story rather than an audio audit—did you simply send it to AI?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Instead of an audio audit, the result is a story on a different theme in English. You simply gave the task to AI, and it failed to understand your prompt. Good job.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hi there, Marcus.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I'm waiting for a response after sending this feedback to my Danish specialist.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I can see that you've already ended the contract, but could you possibly let me correct this within 10 hours??

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Sorry, but if this was done via AI, even though the task requires listening and marking errors, and the text audit was handled the same way, we can't risk this project. We're not prepared to take another chance. Thank you.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Marcus, give me 10 hours and I'll sort it out!!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: As we said, we're in a rush with this one, and we've found a new auditor. Will we also have to pay for services that check whether text was made with AI?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: That's understandable, Marcus. Alright then.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For the initial revision, though, I'd argue that some compensation is in order.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Your position makes sense to me, but the job wasn't done and I can't use what an ai produced. Because of that, I have to start over.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Marcus, I personally handled the initial revision.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The initial revision wasn't made with AI.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: If you have a Danish specialist on your side, how could you have handled it yourself?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Proofreading made up most of the initial revision, and that's my field.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Are you saying you can prepare the text for a correct voiceover, yet you can't check the resulting voiceover?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Unlike the earlier proofreading task, today's work involved voice revision, and I have a network of content specialists I work with.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: We'll have to begin again because this is too complicated and we can't use the text.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Marcus, is the voice revision really the only setback here? This doesn't need to be complicated, right??

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Restarting isn't necessary; I can assure you that the proofreading is 100% accurate.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: No. Since the voiceover was made using AI, I think the audit was created the same way, so I can't use it. I'll have to pay full price and start all over again.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Marcus, I completely understand. The initial revision is 100% accurate, I assure you. If you can give me an additional 10 hours, I'll get the voice revision sorted out; I've already contacted my other specialist, and she's available now, waiting for my go-ahead.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: That's totally fine if you say you can't work with it.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could we agree on some compensation for the initial revision? I'd really appreciate it.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Here's an offer: submit this as the first audio audit, and we'll check it. We'll also recheck the text with the "use ai" service. If both the text and the audit are okay, we'll cancel the refund.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright, I've started working on it.
